features.name: Controlled-alpha Bridge and Crew authorization boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Bridge and Crew are available to founder, internal, and beta audiences while public production remains closed.
Bridge request creation is RPC-only, accepts only teen-owned Journal and Mood sources, and never grants a parent raw source access.
Crew share creation and revocation are RPC-only, every share owner matches the referenced check-in owner, and recipient access requires an active accepted unblocked relationship.
Revoked, blocked, removed, unrelated, anonymous, and cross-user actors are denied through rollback-contained live probes before controlled-alpha distribution.
Production routing and production Bridge rollout remain fail-closed until a separate founder decision.

rollout.controlKey: beta audience plus disabled Worker rollout until a founder-approved exact-account allowlist is provisioned

verification.blocker: Complete-checkout TypeScript, unit, migration, Wrangler bundle, and browser checks must execute; the reviewed migrations must be applied through an approved path; the catalog parity probe and live RLS, grants, RPC signatures, source ownership, blocked/revoked denial, deletion cleanup, two-account journeys, and device evidence remain unexecuted. GitHub-hosted jobs currently fail before step one and do not count as execution evidence.

features.rollback: Leave PR #495 unmerged or revert its focused commits. Before any live rollout, keep both feature flags disabled or beta-scoped and keep both Worker configurations disabled. After an approved migration application, use a reviewed forward rollback migration that restores prior functions and policies without deleting user content; revoke the alpha account allowlist and preview distribution immediately if any privacy stop condition occurs.
